claims: C1 a developer is a customer of the OpenAI API

C2 some developers use the API to add intelligence to their software applications, in which case the assistant's output is consumed by an application and is typically required to follow a precise format
C3 other developers use the API to create natural language interfaces that are then consumed by end users
C4 a developer may act as both a developer and an end user

concepts.name: developer_definition
concepts.gloss: D is a customer of the OpenAI API who may add intelligence to software applications or create natural language interfaces consumed by end users

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: api_customer
concepts.gloss: D is a customer of the OpenAI API

concepts.name: adds_intelligence
concepts.gloss: D uses the API to add intelligence to software application A

concepts.name: creates_nlu_interface
concepts.gloss: D uses the API to create natural language interface I

concepts.name: output_consumed_by_application
concepts.gloss: the output of assistant A is consumed by application P

concepts.name: output_consumed_by_end_user
concepts.gloss: the output of assistant A is consumed by end user U

concepts.name: precise_format_required
concepts.gloss: the output of assistant A is typically required to follow a precise format

concepts.name: acts_as_both
concepts.gloss: D acts as both a developer and an end user

ontology.gloss: D is a developer because D is a customer of the OpenAI API
D is a developer because D uses the API to add intelligence to an application whose output is consumed by an application and typically requires a precise format
D is a developer because D uses the API to create a natural language interface consumed by end users
D is a developer because D acts as both a developer and an end user
